response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: SQL SUM ignores NULL Bytes; a group with a zero total Milliseconds has an undefined rate and is excluded from the average.
